completeness.meaning: complete means every expected final evidence record is present and parseable, including explicit blocked records. closed/allChecksPassed require every requested check to have executed and passed.

blocked.reason: Managed preview exited during startup: listen EPERM: operation not permitted 127.0.0.1

The managed preview failed to start with EPERM while binding 127.0.0.1. Sites managed preview instructions prohibit substituting a server or changing network permissions to bypass that failure. The parent directed this check to remain unrun.

guidance.note: Documentation baseline differs intentionally from the deployed Sites performance baseline.

container.note: Effective cgroup quota: 4 CPU cores and 16 GiB. os.cpus()/totalmem() fields describe the visible host, not this quota.

baseline.method: Local production HTTP/workerd/D1; closed-loop concurrency; synthetic learning histories; no paid provider; full body consumed; warm-up excluded; 3 rounds. Optional soak: 12 concurrent readers, full journal/memory/index/shell requests.

candidate.method: Local production HTTP/workerd/D1; closed-loop concurrency; synthetic learning histories; no paid provider; full body consumed; warm-up excluded; 3 rounds. Optional soak: 12 concurrent readers, full journal/memory/index/shell requests.

comparison.statistics: Nearest-rank percentiles of pooled raw request samples; throughput=sum(n)*1000/sum(elapsedMs). Route contribution RPS uses the whole mixed-run time denominator.

soak.segmentAttribution: Requests grouped by start timestamp; each latency includes its complete response, even across a 30-second boundary.
soak.scope: Closed-loop local read workload only; no writes/provider calls; 120 seconds is not a production endurance test.

sourceSnapshot.scope: Current production source/assets, test fixtures, build/QA scripts, configuration, CI and immutable migrations. Excludes artifacts/, docs and generated data/audit-summary.json to avoid evidence self-reference and audit timestamp churn.

provenance.note: Source snapshot hashes current worktree bytes; a Git HEAD alone does not identify uncommitted candidate changes. Final report uses only the named final evidence, not prior f107/pre-merge benchmark results.

limits: Closed-loop synthetic local HTTP/D1 workload has coordinated omission; no open-loop production capacity claim.
Three HTTP rounds and 120-second read soak do not establish statistical significance or long-term production stability.
Browser SSE/model responses are controlled fixtures; no real paid provider, WAN, production identity gateway, physical iPad/Safari or INP measurement.
Component render counts and synchronous commit timings are separate from whole-app interaction timings.
Manual scoped reviews do not replace a formal Security Cloud scan; deployment and live migration validation are separate later evidence.
